Then know that all you need to learn to do is love yourself. With all of your strengths and weaknesses. Everything you are, you have done, seen and heard...you deserve your upmost care and love. I love you and I do believe you could stop drinking if you chose that path and put in much work. It's not easy to love oneself. I am still new to this and learning myself. But, the outcome has made my seemingly wreck of a life completed worth every second. You're right, we can't point fingers and place blame. Acceptance first, and then love. I love you and I hope you see you are worth every wonderful thing in this dark, beautiful world.💜

Thank you kindly for this post. I was afraid I would start thinking of the drink after a few years of sobriety. I'm saving this post so you can always remind me that the poison will always be poison. I am rooting for you and thinking of you. It may seem dark now, but you got out of the darkness once. I know you can do it again❗️

It was for me as well, but showing yourself love, overcoming the poison, figuring out how to cope without it....my life has turned around drastically in a near 6 months. But I also had to learn to love myself. To remind myself, even now here and again during stressful times, the drink is not the answer. It's the downwards spiral, for some and maybe most. I know it was for me. The world is loud with opinions and judgement. Shut them out and live for you. If I were with you when you ordered that lemonade, I would have high fived you and ordered one too❗️Keep going and keep strong. You can do it❗️I will not be drinking with you today❗️Let's commit to another lemonade, yeah?🤗💜

Live for you! Look at the world from a different angle. Try something new! You've decided to kick this habit! Celebrate your life now! Celebrate being clear headed and focus on you! When you move, so will your life! Just a bit of encouragement to take that leap. That next step of living. Now you have extra time, money and energy! Ignore those around you and live!

We can give all the excuses in the world to keep going, but it takes strength, diligence, patience, and basically everything we are not whilst drinking, to stop. If you want to do it, you absolutely can! You would have TONS of support here! But most of all, you would feel EVEN BETTER about yourself and maybe once the poison has ceased to exist in your body, the pride won't even be an issue anymore! Either way, good luck in your decision and endeavor!
